summary: Subscribes a client Cables patch to a WebSocket channel/topic on a remote or localhost WebSocket server.

ports.name: Client Connection
ports.text: The Client Connection object from Ops.Local.Standalone.WebSocketClient.

ports.name: Channel
ports.text: The channel/topic to subscribe to. Use '*' to receive all messages.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Enable or disable message reception for this subscription.

ports.name: Auto Parse JSON
ports.text: Automatically parses string payloads into JavaScript objects.

ports.name: On Message
ports.text: Fires whenever a matching message arrives.

ports.name: Message Channel
ports.text: The actual channel name of the received message.

ports.name: Data
ports.text: The parsed data payload (object, array, string, number).

ports.name: Raw Message
ports.text: The raw string representation of the payload.

ports.name: Sender Client ID
ports.text: ID of the client that sent this message ('patch' if emitted internally by the host).

ports.name: Total Received
ports.text: Cumulative count of messages received on this subscription.

ports.name: Timestamp
ports.text: Timestamp when the message was dispatched.
